The former gun docking area may be represented only by low neutral industrial rails, without any weapon present. Nearly frontal lateral composition, with one continuous level metal/concrete floor strip across the lower quarter, completely clear for combat; all power cells, conduits and cases remain behind it. Detailed semi-realistic environment painting, grounded dark grey metal, selective teal and red status light, restrained cold haze, no fantasy technology. One continuous room, no text, watermark, logo or collage. The visible wall section is expanded into a source-guided lateral adaptation; full-room geometry, precise counts and distances are not certified1:1.
